content: SQLite WAL concurrency: unlimited concurrent readers, single writer only; checkpoint can require an exclusive lock that blocks readers; if there is always at least one active reader, checkpoints never complete and the WAL file grows unbounded — need 'reader gaps'; SQLite is not designed for true multi-process concurrent writes, contention drops write throughput as processes increase; .db-shm shared-memory file is a single point of failure for WAL coordination.
